leagues.name: Samoa National League (FFS National Premier League)

note: League (run in 2025 as the FFS National Premier League) has 12 member clubs in total; 2025 champions were Vaipuna, with Vaivase-Tai 3rd. 8 clubs were confirmed by name this session via Championship Round fixtures (Lepea, Vaitele-Uta, USP Alafua Campus, Vaivase-Tai, Vailima Kiwi, Vaipuna, Sogi, Lupe o le Soaga); the remaining ~4 clubs could not be verified.
